title: Capture a stage's run as a case
body:
## Summary

Spec only. Part of #1151 (the first of #1150's steps): capturing a triage, design or implement run as a case, so that its stage can be run on the same input again. Whole-pipeline capture and replay leave the spec.

```diff
 docs/specs/
-├── replay.md        # capture a spec change or issue, replay the whole pipeline
+├── benchmarks.md    # cases: what one run was given, captured from its run
 ├── product.md       # principle "Tuned against real work", Areas row
 ├── operation.md     # `capture ID NAME`; a case's items and commits aren't redacted
 ├── design_system.md # the run page offers to capture the run
 └── architecture.md
 GLOSSARY.md          # + Case
```

A case, as the stage was given it when Linewright decided to start the run:

```text
cases/<name>/
  stage, item, start, run ID
  items        the item, its parent, its spec change, its open filed spec gaps,
               as GitHub's API gave them, comments before the start only
  repository   bare git repo: the branch heads at the start and their history, nothing else
  criteria     what a good result is (optional)
```

- Input is recorded at each run's start, so only runs from then on can be captured.
- Kept in GitHub's and git's own terms, not Linewright's prompts or types, so that changes to Linewright leave cases usable.
- Like Warp Factories' benchmark tasks: pinned commits, plain-text criteria, a pointer to the source run.

## Evidence

- `scripts/check markdown model-tables model-quotes model-coverage`: ok.
- Reviewed with `spec-review` (consistency and writing), with the findings folded in.
- No UI change.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Spec only. The code still has the old `lw capture` and `lw replay` until #1151 is built, and `docs/tuning-briefs.md` still describes them.

**Blast Radius:** spec
